card.text: Rapidly rotating A-type star 5.13 parsecs away; its photosphere is not imaged here.

introduction.text: Altair spins so fast that its equator bulges to 2.03 solar radii while its poles sit at 1.63. It is drawn that shape, 5.13 parsecs away.

sources.label: Monnier et al. 2007
sources.locator: Table of model parameters, row Req (R⊙), second model

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: Measured colour, with hot bright poles and a cool equator from the star's fast spin. The darker edge is a model.
